crossRefs.note: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”
Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on…
For Yahweh says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing…
As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You…
No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open…

translations.web: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?
translations.bsb: Why were there knees to receive me, and breasts that I should be nursed?
translations.kjv: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
translations.asv: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should suck?
